segments.titre: Hook: no stomach pump and no antidote for a GLP-1 overdose
segments.resume: Unlike many drug overdoses, an Ozempic or Wegovy overdose cannot be treated by pumping the stomach, because GLP-1 medicines bypass the digestive system. There is no antidote and no way to flush the drug out. A small dosing miscalculation can trigger a 72-hour metabolic emergency that medicine cannot switch off.
segments.texte: If you overdose on a drug, an ER can pump your stomach. Take too much of a weight loss shot and it’s a different, terrifying reality. GLP-1 medicines like Ozempic and Wegovy bypass your digestive system completely. There’s no flushing it out. There’s no antidote. Just one slight miscalculation in dosing triggered a 72 hour metabolic emergency. And medical science has no way to turn it off.

segments.titre: Dr. Leslie Golden and other causes of overdose
segments.resume: Obesity medicine physician Dr. Leslie Golden says many overdose stories stem from fragmented care, poor education, influencer misinformation and desperation rather than the drug itself. segments.titre: Trauma, medical bills and approved GLP-1s only
segments.resume: The experience was traumatic and expensive, and the medical bills remind the patient of it. The new in-person physician insists that from now on only approved GLP-1 medication will be used.
segments.texte: But the entire horrific experience has been traumatic… and expensive. The pain you went through, and the medical bills you owe, are a reminder. One your new, in-person physician insists on as well. From here on out, it’ll be approved GLP-1 medication only.

segments.titre: Outro: the Ozempic miracle, a lifelong nightmare
segments.resume: The video closes by noting GLP-1s are touted as a miracle drug but the truth is darker than people admit, and points viewers to a follow-up video titled The Ozempic miracle. A lifelong NIGHTMARE.
segments.texte: GLP-1’s are being touted as a miracle drug. But the truth behind it is darker than anyone wants to admit. Watch “The Ozempic miracle. A lifelong NIGHTMARE” to find out why. Or click on this.
